name: Agensi
description: Agensi is the curated marketplace for AI agent skills. Search security-scanned SKILL.md skills by keyword, category, or task. Preview skill details, ratings, and credit prices. Install paid skills with credits directly from your conversation. Every skill on Agensi passes an 8-point automated security scan, AI intent review, and manual human review before going live. Skills work across Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and 20+ other agents. Free to search. Credits required for paid installs. One balance for web and MCP.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Agensi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Agensi to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.agensi.io/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Agensi MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Agensi provides these MCP tools: search_skills, get_popular, list_categories, get_skill, install_skill, my_credits, my_library, my_purchases, get_creator, get_skill_requests, and submit_skill_request.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Agensi?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Agensi in developer-tools on the Manufact MCP catalog include Held at the Gate, Speko, turva.dev, AgentMail, and Celesto Cloud Computers.
Agensi requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Agensi is developed by Agensi. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
